notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 21
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug with prestige achievement on Windows

notes.title: Prestige Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I've just completed the prestige update for Shot Supreme! This new prestige mechanic allows players to reset their progress, after reaching a certain score, in exchange for special prestige tokens. Players exchange prestige tokens for special permanent upgrades, like the ability to merge two balls together! I hope you enjoy the new system, I'll be listening for feedback.

Cheers,
Bronson

[b]UPDATE NOTES[/b]

[u]PRESTIGE UPDATE[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a prestige option. Players can reset their progress in order to earn prestige tokens and buy permanent upgrades.
[*] BIG NUMBERS. High scores and no longer capped, numbers can grow indefinitely.
[*] Added a new achievement for prestiging.
[/list]

[u]Bug fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Accuracy of the auto ball is no longer dependent on your preview line bonus.
[*] Fixed an issue where level indicators weren't updating immediately.
[*] Upgraded save to version 4, adding more data.
[/list]

notes.title: Prestige system coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi Folks!

After compiling your feedback, I've started working on a big content update for Shot Supreme! The focus of the update is to introduce a new Prestige system. The system allows players to pick a permanent upgrade at the cost of restarting their progress. Players collect multiple permanent upgrades by continuing to prestige, unlocking higher scores than ever! This system will bring more depth and gameplay to the already addictive loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44184137/02096ea4104efa3b1b1bf1ca9166eac7654eb8d4.png[/img]

I look forward to sharing it with you soon!

Cheers,
Bronson

notes.title: Shot Supreme is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi there! Bronson here, the man behind the one-person game studio BrightWorm and the developer of the game Shot Supreme!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44184137/ad3ff24168919505f13c28cbd8336e5e0ce135f4.png[/img]

Shot Supreme is available now! It's the first game I've made entirely solo, and I'm super excited to share it with you.

Shot Supreme is an arcade basketball game inspired by incremental games. It's like a clicker, but you have to score baskets instead of simply clicking. The game provides a chill, zen-like experience when you want to zone out and relax a little.

If you have suggestions, feedback, or issues, you can find me at the [url=https://discord.gg/MDD8byQpsW]official BrightWorm discord server[/url].

Thanks so much for checking out my game!

Cheers,
Bronson
